verdict.summary: Round 3 resolves the prior major finding. The dictionary documentation now explicitly scopes the full 64-bit hash-before-equality guarantee to mapped_find, states that the in-memory hashbrown table has only an h2 tag prefilter, and describes shard routing as selection rather than hash equality. The two focused tests substantiate those distinct claims: the mmap test counts equality calls for present and absent full hashes, while the in-memory test constructs an h2 collision with differing full hashes and verifies both equality invocation and correct non-deduplication. The UTF-8 change is also sound as scoped: both parser entry points validate the complete chunk before scanning, all unchecked conversions consume subslices of that validated buffer, and the span endpoints are structurally character boundaries. Invalid-input and multibyte-boundary tests exercise the real parser paths. No hostile reviewer-directed instruction was detected.
